STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast-style plate with scrambled eggs, sausage-style patties (looks like chicken or pork breakfast links, cut into rounds), a mixed green salad, and a red sauce (likely hot sauce or salsa/ketchup-type) on top of the eggs. Photographed from above, roughly top-down with slight perspective.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Square white plate, about 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm². Food covers roughly 75% of the plate.

STEP 3 - Items: mixed leafy greens, scrambled eggs, sausage rounds (about 18-20 pieces, each roughly 2.5 cm diameter, 1 cm thick), red sauce.

STEP 4 - Area (share of plate):
- Mixed greens: ~25% (about 130 cm²)
- Scrambled eggs: ~15% (about 80 cm²)
- Sausage rounds: ~25% (about 130 cm²)
- Red sauce: ~7% (about 35 cm²)
- Sum ≈ 72%, consistent with the visible coverage.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Greens: 130 cm² x 3 cm ≈ 390 ml
- Eggs: 80 cm² x 2 cm ≈ 160 ml
- Sausage: 130 cm² x 1.2 cm ≈ 156 ml
- Sauce: 35 cm² x 0.4 cm ≈ 14 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Greens: 390 x 0.15 ≈ 58 g
- Eggs: 160 x 0.95 ≈ 152 g
- Sausage: 156 x 0.95 ≈ 148 g
- Sauce: 14 x 1.0 ≈ 14 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Greens: 58 g x 20 kcal/100g ≈ 12 kcal
- Eggs (scrambled, cooked with some fat): 152 g x 150 kcal/100g ≈ 228 kcal
- Sausage rounds (pork/chicken breakfast sausage): 148 g x 300 kcal/100g ≈ 444 kcal
- Red sauce (hot sauce/ketchup-type): 14 g x 40 kcal/100g ≈ 6 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 372 g and ≈ 690 kcal. This is plausible for a full breakfast plate with eggs and sausage, with a light salad.
